summary: Verified merged internal patient search + calendar booking bug fix. 11/11 backend pytest tests pass (portal search by email/dob/phone/name; portal-first ordering; /internal/directory regression; dedup with matched_directory_id; booking a verified portal patient via patient_id creates appt visible in that patient's portal; unverified rejected; missing ids rejected; directory booking still works). Frontend: /internal/patients search for 'Lopez' -> Maria Lopez surfaces first with 'PIN Not assigned · VERIFIED — PORTAL PATIENT'; snapshot shows green 'VERIFIED — PORTAL PATIENT' badge and 'Not assigned' PIN. Calendar Book dialog: opening an open slot -> search 'maria' -> Maria Lopez appears first with green 'PORTAL' tag and 'PIN Not assigned · Verified portal patient'. All test data and appointments cleaned up (0 residuals). No pre-existing records modified. Availability doc untouched.

minor.issue: Multi-token full-name queries return 0 results. q='maria lopez' -> 0 hits, while q='maria' and q='Lopez' each work. The regex ORs each field against the whole escaped query string, so no field contains both tokens. Impact: if staff types full name with a space, nothing appears. Suggest splitting on whitespace and ANDing token regexes across first_name/last_name (or matching against full_name).

action_items: (Minor / optional) Improve /internal/patient-lookup so multi-token full-name searches like 'maria lopez' also find the patient. Split query on whitespace and AND per-token regexes across first_name & last_name, or index a normalized full_name field. Same fix should be considered for the directory search branch inside _search_patients_merged.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2477 lines — consider splitting into routers (patients/, calendar/, portal/, admin/) for maintainability (guideline: files >700 lines).
_search_patients_merged: portal query and directory query both use the same raw qn, causing the multi-token issue noted above.
_portal_search_ors uses `date_of_birth: {$regex: qn}` and `phone: {$regex: digits-with-\D*}` on unindexed fields — fine at current data volumes but note for later indexing.
seed_data_creation: Two temp patients created inside tests (dedup + unverified) and one dedup-linked patient — all deleted by module teardown; two TEST_-tagged appointments (portal booking + directory booking) created and deleted along with their reminders; TEST_-tagged notifications/outbound_notifications purged. Post-run DB scan: 0 residual TEST_ appts / temp patients / TEST_ notifications / TEST_ outbound. Availability doc unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fix is solid; regression covered by /app/backend/tests/test_internal_patient_search.py. Only outstanding polish item is multi-token name search (see minor issue). UI booking dialog uses [data-testid^='calendar-open-slot'] for open slots; Patients page uses [data-testid='patient-lookup-search'/'patient-lookup-search-btn'/'patient-lookup-result'/'patient-snapshot']. Env date 2026-09-22, TZ America/Toronto; open slots easily found in week 2026-09-22 (e.g. Thu 2026-09-24 11:30 AM).
rca of the issue: Original bug: /internal/patient-lookup queried patient_directory only, so a portal-registered patient who was VERIFIED but not yet linked to a directory row was invisible to internal staff (and un-bookable from the calendar dialog which used the same endpoint). Fix (verified): new _search_patients_merged first queries the `patients` collection (verified+active) via _portal_search_ors (name/email/hcn/pin/dob/phone) and emits snapshots flagged source='portal', patient_status='PORTAL_PATIENT'; if a portal record has matched_directory_id, the linked directory row is emitted instead so it appears once; then any remaining directory hits are appended. calendar_book now accepts patient_id in addition to directory_id and 400s if the portal patient isn't verified or neither id is provided. /internal/directory endpoint intentionally left directory-only for AppointmentQueue's link-patient flow.
